create_plot_bisect_kmeans: create a script that compares Bisecting K-Means and K-Means clustering on synthetic blob data
run_bisecting_kmeans: run BisectingKMeans clustering with 4, 8, and 16 clusters on generated blob data
run_kmeans_clustering: run KMeans clustering with 4, 8, and 16 clusters on generated blob data
plot_clustering_results: plot clustering results with scatter plots showing cluster centers for each algorithm
generate_blobs_dataset: generate synthetic blob dataset with 10000 samples and 2 centers for clustering
